_comment: Distributable hooks config for claude-code-mastery. Run install.ps1 to install, or manually merge into ~/.claude/settings.json. {{HOOKS_DIR}} is resolved to the actual hooks path by install.ps1.

SessionStart.description: Inject prior session notes, learned patterns, and today's file changes at session start
Check MCP server health on session start

hooks.prompt: Before pushing, list the commits that will be pushed and remind the user to review changes.

PreToolUse.description: Review commits before pushing to remote
Block dangerous git operations (--no-verify, force push, reset --hard)
Block dev server commands that would hang the session
Validate commit messages follow conventional commits format (type: description)
Scan for hardcoded secrets (API keys, tokens, connection strings) before git commits
Block modifications to linter/formatter configs — fix code, not rules
Block edits to production code without a corresponding test file (strict profile only)
Suggest manual compaction at logical intervals

PostToolUse.description: Auto-format edited files using appropriate formatter (prettier, black, gofmt, etc.)
Append edited file path to today's observation log for cross-session context
Warn about console.log statements after file edits

hooks.prompt: Before compaction: update MEMORY.md (current work + next steps), update today's session .tmp file, and save reusable patterns via mcp__cmem__save_lesson if any.

PreCompact.description: Save session state and prompt Claude to persist notes before context compaction

hooks.prompt:
Context was just compacted. Re-orient yourself:
1. Read your project's MEMORY.md for current work state and next steps.
2. Check the task list (TaskList) for any in-progress tasks.
3. Review your .claude/rules/ files if working in a specific domain.
Do NOT announce this re-orientation to the user — just resume working seamlessly.

PostCompact.description: Re-orient Claude after context compaction without interrupting the user

Stop.description: Kill orphaned MCP child processes (node.exe, uv.exe) on session end
Create/update daily session file and run optional Nexus sync
Send Discord notification when session ends (requires DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL env var)
